options.text_cn: 一个棋子穿越对方棋子，攻击到该棋子背后的目标
options.text_en: A piece attacks a target beyond an opposing piece along the same line

options.text_cn: 一个棋子同时攻击对方两个目标
options.text_en: A piece attacks two opposing targets at the same time

options.text_cn: 牺牲一个棋子换取更大利益
options.text_en: Sacrifice a piece to gain a greater advantage

options.text_cn: 移走己方棋子，暴露后方棋子的攻击线
options.text_en: Move one of your own pieces to uncover an attack by a piece behind it

explanation_cn: 透视攻击是指己方棋子穿透对方棋子，攻击其身后的目标。对方棋子虽然挡在中间，但透视棋子实际上已经盯住了更深处的目标，一旦中间棋子离开，威胁立即爆发。
explanation_en: An X-ray attack occurs when a piece aims through an opposing piece at a target behind it on the same rank, file, or diagonal. The intervening piece may currently block the line, but if it moves, the attack on the deeper target is revealed.
